thread:
anya: Heads-up — legal asked for a clear doc on who can see customer audit exports and which principals are allowed to request them. They want examples for Dedicated vs Private, and a statement on KMS ops. :eyes:

mike: Can we scope this to two questions: (1) read visibility in the console/api, and (2) export/download rights? Those are often conflated.

kevin: +1. Also call out service accounts vs user tokens. Scoped tokens should never grant export unless explicitly allowed by role.

lisa: Quick note: we currently have roles: org_admin, tenant_admin, tenant_member, audit_reader. But audit_reader is only internal; not exposed to customers. We need a customer-facing role map.

anya: Right — legal wants: "Which RBAC roles can see raw audit events (with PII) vs masked/summary events?" and "Who can trigger an export and download the raw blob?"

mike: Proposal: default behavior: tenant_admin + org_admin -> full raw audit view & export. tenant_member -> metadata-only (no PII). audit_reader -> read-only raw but cannot export. Service accounts: require explicit flag `allow_audit_export:true` in their role binding.

kevin: For Private deployments, ops teams might need `allow_audit_export` for on-prem troubleshooting. That should be documented as an operator opt-in and gated by KMS access.

security-bot: Automated check: ensure `export` APIs validate principal has both RBAC flag and key unwrap permission from KMS.

lisa: KMS rule: decrypt/unveil of export blobs requires an ARN-bound key policy that only allows principals in the org_admin/tenant_admin groups AND `serviceAccount:X` when flagged. If KMS cannot prove binding, return 403.

mike: Schema change: we need to add `principal_type` and `effective_roles` at top-level of audit events so downstream viewers can filter without doing extra lookups. That will be a minor schema bump (v2).

kevin: Example snippet for the event header we discussed:

```
{"event_id":"...",
 "ts":"...",
 "tenant_id":"t-123",
 "principal": "u-456",
 "principal_type": "user|service_account",
 "effective_roles": ["tenant_admin","audit_reader"]
}
```

lisa: Make sure `principal` is hashed/pseudonymized in customer-facing summaries unless the requesting principal has explicit PII permission.

anya: Good call. For customer-facing audit previews (the inline UI), strip or mask fields tagged `sensitive:true` in the schema. Full export will be available only with `export` permission + KMS unwrap.

mike: For validation: add an endpoint `POST /audit/exports/validate` that returns a signed proof (audit export request id) showing the requester had the required roles and KMS wrap approval. Customers can present that when asking for support.

kevin: Also add contract tests:
- role -> allowed_resources matrix test
- scoped-token negative test (scoped token without `allow_audit_export` should 403)
- KMS deny path returns 403 and an audit event about denied unwrap

lisa: Incident/triage note: if an export appears in S3/GCS, we must record `export_blob_created` event with `creator_principal`, `creator_ip`, `kms_key_id`, and `retention_policy` so we can prove chain-of-custody.

sre-ops: For Dedicated: we need a migration plan to backfill `principal_type`+`effective_roles` into existing logs. Suggest running a one-time job that annotates historical events and emits `schema_migration` events so customers see no gaps.

anya: Action items:
- mike: draft customer-facing RBAC matrix and legal blurb (due EOD Wed).
- kevin: PR for schema bump + contract tests (start tomorrow).
- lisa: KMS key policy template and operator opt-in doc (add examples for AWS/GCP HSM).
- sre-ops: propose backfill job and estimate runtime/cost.

mike: I'll ping @legal once draft is ready. :+1:

kevin: one more thing — add a short FAQ entry: "Why can't members export audit logs?" short answer: separation of duties + KMS gating.

lisa: tagging compliance for review once docs are drafted.

anya: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as the canonical convo for the request. If anyone wants to edit the action items, reply here.
